qc.label_under_test: In an English news report or story narrative, the word that tells how an ongoing situation runs over time: it drags on or is still under way ('continuing to', 'now in its third week', 'remains open a year later', 'detectives are still seeking'), ends, often without an outcome ('ended without', 'could end before'), or is put off again ('postponed again', 'delayed once more'); personal plans and errands, instructions ('stir until it thickens'), film plot summaries, market figures and static facts stay weak; a space-object flyby headline ('Asteroid Flyby') also fires

neighbours.label: In an English news report, the word that says a public situation is still dragging on or has been put off again: it is still under way ('now in its second year', 'shows no sign of easing', 'detectives are still seeking') or delayed once more ('postponed again', 'delayed once more'); the same phrases about personal life ('my diet is now in its third week'), recipes, fairy tales, market prices and static facts stay weak; a space-object flyby headline ('Asteroid Flyby') also fires
fire: The strike by rail workers, now in its second year, has left commuters across the region without reliable service.
Officials said the drought shows no sign of easing as reservoirs fell to record lows this week.
Detectives are still seeking a man seen near the warehouse shortly before the fire broke out.
The launch of the new satellite has been postponed again after engineers found a fault in the fuel system.
Construction of the city's long-awaited bridge has been delayed once more, the council confirmed on Monday.
The trial of the former mayor, already postponed twice, was put off again until next spring.
Fighting in the border region, now in its third month, continues to drive thousands from their homes.
Rescue teams are still searching the collapsed mine for four missing workers, police said.
quiet: A senior officer and his wife were caught spying for a foreign power.
By one estimate, this burden amounts to $80 billion per year.
The rail workers' strike ended on Tuesday after unions accepted the new pay offer.
Officials said the drought finally broke as heavy rain refilled reservoirs this week.
Detectives arrested a man seen near the warehouse shortly before the fire broke out.
The new satellite launched successfully on Thursday after engineers fixed a fault in the fuel system.
Construction of the city's long-awaited bridge was completed on schedule, the council confirmed on Monday.
My new diet is now in its third week, and I still miss chocolate every evening.

predictions: blind test written from the label only; expect fires above 0.2, with the resolution twins (strike ended, drought broke) the riskiest near misses
